title: Zesty Gooey Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Indulge in the bold flavors of Brazil with these tangy and gooey chicken skewers, featuring sweet peppadew peppers and pickles, all while being Whole30-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, lime juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated chicken, peppadew peppers, and pickle slices onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the peppers are slightly charred.
Brush the skewers with the remaining marinade during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a side of cauliflower rice or roasted vegetables.
